description:
A collection of windows quality update profiles

TIP: Lists Windows quality update profiles — expedited security updates that bypass the quality deferral of the device's Windows Update for Business ring. Each has displayName, expeditedUpdateSettings {qualityUpdateRelease, daysUntilForcedReboot}, deployableContentDisplayName, releaseDateDisplayName. Use $expand=assignments for target groups. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $expand, $count.
